title: Layoffs at OpenAI
subtitle: Employees were fired for mishandling sensitive information
excerpt: OpenAI fires employees for sharing data
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
OpenAI has laid off employees due to the mishandling of sensitive information.

Investigation

The former employees were investigated for sharing data with an external artificial intelligence evaluation group.

This measure was taken after it was discovered that these employees did not handle confidential information correctly.

With information from BBC News.
